primary.why: The Planetary Pack is the cleanest current route because it bundles Alpha Centauri with the Alien Crossfire expansion. Compatibility and unofficial patch choices matter, so the archive should log whether it is preserving the base game, expansion content, or a patched modern setup.
primary.how_to_play: Use GOG or Steam Planetary Pack on PC. Record storefront/build, official/unofficial patch state, base game versus Alien Crossfire, faction/scenario settings, difficulty, multiplayer state, and any compatibility fixes.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting exact launch-era behavior.
secondary.why: Planetary Pack is the better current ownership route.
